mapper.select: SELECT YEAR_MONTH, INCOME, EXPENSE FROM FINANCE_MONTHLY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY YEAR_MONTH DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: MERGE INTO FINANCE_MONTHLY t USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID, #{yearMonth} AS YEAR_MONTH FROM DUAL) s ON (t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID AND t.YEAR_MONTH = s.YEAR_MONTH) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.INCOME = #{income}, t.EXPENSE = #{expense} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FINANCE_MONTHLY_ID, MEMBER_ID, YEAR_MONTH, INCOME, EXPENSE) VALUES (SEQ_FINANCE_MONTHLY.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{yearMonth}, #{income}, #{expense})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FINANCE_MONTHLY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND YEAR_MONTH = #{yearMonth}
